text:
The dentist worked very quickly. 3 teeth in less than an hour.
* When I got home, I couldn't use dental floss on 2 teeth; the floss wouldn't go down. I contacted them to get it fixed. The dentist fixed it by removing the old filling and redoing it, charging an extra 600 baht. They said that day they charged 900 baht per tooth. If I had mentioned that I wanted this type of filling from the beginning (meaning I could use floss?), they would have charged 1,200 baht. So I had to pay extra. I asked the dentist if it wasn't a corrective job, and they said it wasn't because they did a bad job, but because my teeth were too close together.
* The filling is on a front tooth, and the filling material is a different color from the tooth.
* The tooth that was filled is larger than the other tooth on the same side.
* They pressed very hard, causing abrasion.

☺️ The admin responded to the chat very quickly.
author_name: เปรมกมล ใหม่กาศ (บุ๋มบิ๋ม)
